notes:
Top-line: mid-market product search SaaS. Looking to improve 'help center + product docs' relevance with reranking layer.
POC flow: start on Hosted API for quick iteration; if we hit p95 latencies and cost thresholds, move to Dedicated for predictable throughput.
Requirements:
- Rerank endpoint must support batch offline scoring (they call it 'offline scorer') to run through eval sets and produce feature vectors + rerank scores.
- Latency target: ~150ms p95 for rerank stage (they run candidate retrieval + rerank).
- Throughput: 20-40 QPS during business hours, spiky bursts to 100 QPS acceptable with bursts.
- Cost sensitivity: primary decision driver is cost per query at production scale; want clear model for hosted token vs per-request rerank pricing and a Dedicated reservation option.
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS for key management, ability to pin data residency to EU for EU customers.
- Model preferences: open models or smaller fine-tuned rerank specialized models; interest in Redwood's model catalog + verified perf profiles.
- Evaluation: they already have an offline eval set (5k queries + labeled relevance) and want automated regression alerts tied to eval runs.
- Integration notes: will want API for bulk/offline scoring to compare candidate lists vs internal baseline.
Quote from PM: "Need to be sure rerank won't blow our latency SLOs — willing to trade some cost for reliability."
AE/SE notes: keep POC scope tight: 1) batch offline scoring test, 2) live rerank on sample traffic (feature-flagged), 3) cost report + ops runbook.
Next: finalize NDA, send Dedicated pricing worksheet, schedule security evidence handoff (SOC2 excerpts) and prod-traffic POC window.
Staging hints: prefer to test on Hosted API with VPC egress to their logging infra; if ok, move to Dedicated reserved pool trial.
